claim_scores.rationale: Defines `ImageModel` with required `image: dspy.Image`, optional `image_list: list[dspy.Image] | None`, and uses it as `model_input` in a `dspy.Signature`.
Builds `model_input` with one direct image and one list image, attaches it as a demo to a predictor, then dump/load round-trips state before the checked call.
Configures `DummyLM` with `{'output': 'Multiple photos'}`, calls the reloaded predictor, and asserts `out.output == 'Multiple photos'`.
Inspects LM `messages`, counts `image_url` blocks, and asserts the post-round-trip call contains exactly 4 image blocks.
Asserts `'<DSPY_IMAGE_START>' not in str(msgs)`, explicitly checking against placeholder-text flattening.
